newsitem.title: USA: TBC to sell battery unit, post Q4 charge. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: TBC to sell battery unit, post Q4 charge. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects whole story to make clear that discontinued operations are a contributing factor to the company's anticipated Q4 charge.)

TBC Corp said Monday it plans to sell its battery distribution unit, Battery Associate Inc, and discontinue marketing other non-tire products to independent distibutors, resulting in a fourth-quarter pretax charge of about $2.3 million.
TBC said the decision was made "to refocus the company's future growth on the replacement tire business."
TBC said the moves "will have no impact on the tires and other products marketed through the Big O Tires subsidiary which was acquired in July 1996."
